summary: Iteration 24: tested the tutorial pearls reward and the Crew Pond feature (backend and frontend), plus regressions. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed. Tutorial complete gives +10 pearls/+10 worms/+10 bread exactly once. Pond info, stocking rules (order, bank, already stocked, 403 for non-manager or non-member), pond cast (403 with no crew, 400 when empty, only stocked species with water crew_pond), normal cast never gives ids 950-959, pond landing creates a catch plus a journal entry with water crew_pond, and game/data has the 10 pond fish with art. Frontend: final tutorial text and toast mention 10 Pearls (pearls 0->10 in the HUD). On mobile 390x844 the card sits below the player panel (card top 134.7 vs panel bottom 133.9). Crew island: Pond Keeper Maud is visible, the spot prompt opens a modal with 10 cards, and stocking 951 updated progress 1->2/10, bank 197,500->192,500 and showed a toast. All 3 rings show FISH, and a cast posts {spot:'crew_pond'} and starts a fight with species 950 (DB pending water crew_pond). Off the rings the crew-hint shows, SAIL goes to /game/waters, and clubhouse entry works. Millbrook regression: cast with {} hooked species 21 at millbrook.

minor.issue: Trash on a miss uses enhance.roll_trash(user['water']) instead of the pond water. Cosmetic only.

ui_bugs.issue: At 768x1024 the tutorial card (top 74px, x146-622) covers the gold/pearl row of the player panel (panel x9-285, bottom 139). The mobile fix only applies at max-width 640px, so tablet widths 641-~900 still hide the pearls counter.

issues: Pond fish (water crew_pond) only show under 'All waters'. There is no Crew Pond chip because game/data waters does not include crew_pond.
The success toast at the top briefly covers the player panel. It is transient, so minor.

action_items: Extend the .wtut-card offset (top ~150px) to tablet widths, e.g. @media (max-width: 900px), or whenever the card overlaps the player panel horizontally
Optional: add a Crew Pond filter in Fishdex; use the pond water for trash rolls
critical_code_review_comments: crew_pond.pond_stock: if all 10 are stocked, nxt is None and nxt['id'] would crash. It is currently unreachable because the 'already stocked' check runs first for valid ids, but a guard would be safer.
server.py is 4186 lines and should be split into modules.
